summary: Phase-1 Certification Portal end-to-end tested. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases passed (OTP register+verify, unified login for admin/client/reviewer, wrong-password 401, role enforcement 401/403 across /api/client, /api/reviewer, /api/admin/portal, client project CRUD, IGBC v4 template shape 6 categories/100 pts, auto-save + score, submit blocked until mandatories met then succeeds with version, Residential=under_configuration + submit 409, admin dashboard, clients list with project_count, create reviewer + duplicate 409, cert-projects list, assign flow -> reviewer sees assignment). Frontend: client login redirects to /portal/dashboard with client-dashboard testid; Create Project 6-step stepper works and lands on wizard with only Site Selection unlocked (other 5 categories show lock icon); preliminary disclaimer banner visible; reviewer login redirects to /reviewer/dashboard and shows 1 assignment (assignment-* testid). Admin sidebar navigates to Cert Projects (cert-projects-table), Portal Clients, Reviewers (reviewers-table with Add Reviewer button and assign-select dropdown on submitted project). Public regression: home-page loads, Client Portal link appears in public navbar, existing home-services / home-projects / certification-band sections still render.

ui_bugs.issue: Last category (Innovation and Decarbonisation) displays a green 'Complete' badge on a brand-new project even before the user touches any category — likely because the category has zero mandatory prerequisites so the completeness check returns true. This is visually misleading (it also appears in an ambiguous 'locked?' state — no lock icon, but shows Complete). Consider gating 'Complete' behind: category index <= current_category_index AND at least one interaction/save.

action_items: Optional UX polish: don't show 'Complete' badge on the last category (or any category with 0 mandatories) until the user has actually opened/saved it. Currently the last IGBC category appears Complete on a fresh project.
critical_code_review_comments: portal.py `_email_taken` correctly checks both admins and users collections — prevents cross-role collisions.

OTP verify: attempts increment BEFORE returning the error (via $inc + reload of stale count) — the 'remaining' calculation uses stale in-memory `pending.get('attempts')+1` which is correct because the DB $inc happens first line. OK.

score_project response field is `claimed_points` not `points`; the wizard UI must post `{met, claimed_points}` — please ensure the frontend uses this exact key when posting responses (test was corrected accordingly).
IGBC Commercial v4 template has exactly 6 categories totalling 100 points (verified via API).

Assignment endpoint uses status transition submitted -> assigned but does not enforce that the current status is 'submitted' before assigning. Consider adding a guard: `if project['status'] not in ('submitted','changes_requested'): raise HTTPException(409)` to prevent assigning a draft.

portal.py /reviewer/assignments query filters by reviewer_id only (not by status). If a reviewer is unassigned by admin later, the filter still matches — consider adding a `status: {'$in': ['assigned','under_review','changes_requested','approved','rejected']}` filter for safety.
portal.py file is ~490 lines — still within the 700-line guideline but growing. Consider splitting into portal_auth_routes.py, portal_client_routes.py, portal_admin_routes.py as scope grows.
Wizard 'Innovation' category showing 'Complete' on fresh project (see ui_bug) suggests completeness heuristic treats zero-mandatory categories as pre-complete.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created a few TEST_* certification projects (draft + submitted + assigned) via API for the seeded testclient. One reviewer was assigned during test_projects_list_and_assign; ephemeral OTP client and ephemeral reviewer were both cleaned up. Left-over TEST projects are visible in Cert Projects table (safe to keep — filtered by TEST_ prefix in name).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_portal.py -v`. It relies on pre-seeded testclient/testreviewer/admin. Response schema for wizard writes: `{responses: {<crit_id>: {met: bool, claimed_points: int}}}`. To exercise OTP flow, use the mongo-patch trick documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md — bcrypt-hash '123456' into pending_registrations.otp_hash. Frontend testids confirmed working: portal-login-form, login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-btn, client-dashboard, reviewer-dashboard, assignment-<id>, create-project, cp-name/cp-type/cp-next/cp-submit, project-wizard, wizard-cat-<catId>, reviewers-table, cert-projects-table, assign-select-<id>, home-page.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bugs. Only cosmetic issue: wizard sidebar shows 'Complete' for a category that has no mandatory prerequisites even on a fresh project. Likely root cause: completeness = 'all mandatory items met' evaluates to True vacuously when mandatory list is empty. Fix: additionally require category was visited/saved (or `category_index <= current_category_index-1`).
